title: Grays rescued orphaned Chinese children and want to return them to humans

tellings.quote: They were young Chinese people that the grace had rescued, not abducted, but they they had been orphaned and the grace had refued.

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years among alien beings near Area 51, a secret military base in Nevada, says the beings had with them young Chinese people they had rescued, not abducted, after the children were orphaned. He tells it as something he saw himself in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, in the 1960s, and as he tells it, the beings wanted to return these young people to human society. If true, it would mean the beings were caring for human children, not taking them.
